entries.zh: 待人绝情太甚，把人拒之门外（不予分文）
entries.en: to turn a person away empty-handed; to treat someone with excessive harshness
entries.notes: L 栏拼写含混（“siⁿ dar lo nada”疑为 echar sin darle nada），释义主要依 H/M 栏「絕人太甚」。

entries.en: to launch a ship; to put a ship into the water
to cast the ship's anchor into the water; to drop anchor
to cast the anchor into the water

entries.zh: 掷杯占卜，卜问运气吉凶
entries.en: to cast lots; to divine one's fortune (with divination blocks)
entries.notes: H 栏末字「柸/杯」存疑；L 栏 echar la suerte, aventuranza 明示占卜，M 栏 van pūé 与「杯」相应。

entries.zh: 往饭菜里放盐，加盐入味
entries.en: to put salt in the food; to salt food
entries.notes: H 栏「宿鹽」用字罕见、M 栏 chôa 对应不明，释义从 L 栏。

entries.en: to put salt into the food
to lie down; to recline
to lie on one's side
entries.notes: M 栏混入西语词 lado，前段 Pōng 与 H 栏「傍」相应，pē 未详。

entries.en: to lie down; to stretch oneself out
entries.notes: M 栏夹入西语 accostarse，且后半「tò tē cūn」与第 13 条重出，疑原稿互见；H 栏「舒倒堤」用字待考。

entries.zh: 扛上肩头，把货物搭在肩上
entries.en: to shoulder a load; to throw something over one's shoulder
entries.notes: H 栏第三字「育/有」存疑，L 栏末尾 afa 不明；肩扛之义依 L 栏 hecharse al hombro 与 M 栏 thâu 推定。

entries.zh: （如病人倒在别人门前）倒下不起、不再翻身〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: to lie down and not turn over again, like a sick man at another's door
entries.notes: H 栏「蓿、仜」为借音字且存疑，M 栏难以还原，仅能依 L 栏残文 echarse y no se volver... 推为倒下不起。

entries.en: to lie down to sleep
to throw oneself headlong into the water
to fall into the water; to go into the water
to go bad; to spoil; to be ruined
entries.notes: L 栏后半「nonoadoy, uel aman」难解（原件疑有讹脱），核心短语 echarse a perder 明确，H/M 作「敗」。

entries.en: done; finished; accomplished
done; finished; completed

entries.zh: 权且将就做成；临时借用而成
entries.en: done provisionally; done with borrowed means; makeshift
entries.notes: H 栏「權/榷」存疑，然「權且」为成词，与 L 栏 de prestado（借用、临时）相合。

entries.en: temporarily; for the time being
entries.notes: H 栏「權/榷」存疑；「權時」即暂时，与 L 栏 de prestado 相应。
